Inventory Cost Correction

The Inventory Cost Correction screen calculates the appropriate unit costs for inventory items, identifies discrepancies from existing unit costs, and provides suggestions for adjustments.

Accessing Inventory Cost Correction

There are two methods for accessing this feature:

Method 1: Via Settings Tab

  1. Go to the Settings tab and click on Inventory Unit Costs.

    Settings
    InventoryUnitCosts

  2. Click the Inventory Cost Correction button in the bottom-right corner.

    InventoryCostCorrection

Method 2: Via Inventory Items Tab or Financial Statements

  • Go to the Inventory Items tab. Above the Total cost column, select the Recalculate button.
  • Alternatively, you can also select the Recalculate button when drilling down into inventory accounts within your financial statements.

Understanding the Inventory Cost Correction Screen

The Inventory Cost Correction screen displays calculated unit costs and suggested adjustments. The relevant columns include:

  • Effective Date: Date the unit cost applies.
  • Inventory Item: The name of the inventory item concerned.
  • Unit Cost: Suggested unit cost for calculating cost of sales.
  • Action: Recommended action—indicating whether unit costs should be created, updated, or deleted.

Executing Inventory Cost Corrections

To process suggested corrections:

  1. Select all (or desired) changes listed on the screen.
  2. Click Execute Actions at the bottom of the screen.

ExecuteActions

By default, the screen displays up to 50 suggested inventory cost adjustments at once. To handle more than 50 suggested changes:

  • Repeat the correction process multiple times, or
  • Increase the page size setting located in the lower-left corner to process more suggestions simultaneously.

Interaction with Lock Date

The Inventory Cost Correction screen respects established Lock Dates. This ensures that no inventory unit cost adjustments are suggested for periods already locked, preserving historical balances. For more details, see the Lock Date guide.
